# Supplemental source licenses

Hindsight source tag v0.8.3 resolves to `e1014cc790da502effacdb4bc914f8eea670606e`.
`hindsight-LICENSE.txt` is from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/e1014cc790da502effacdb4bc914f8eea670606e/LICENSE. The wheel omits this license file.

pg0 v0.15.2 declares MIT in Cargo.toml but its source archive and wheel
contain no license text. The existing accepted disclosure is retained; no new
claim of complete pg0 license coverage is made.

Wheel notices are extracted verbatim, including upstream CRLF line endings.
Jinja2 and MarkupSafe are mirror-URL changes with identical version and hash.
